10.1 Helper & Utility Scripts – Overview

The ABpE Portal contains a number of helper scripts and utility functions that facilitate development and maintenance tasks. These scripts are divided into two categories: bin/ for executable scripts and management/commands/ for Django-integrated commands.

10.2 Directory Structure of Helpers

apps/abpe_ui/
├── bin/                              # Executable Helper Scripts
│   ├── backup_helper.py              # Backup/Restore functionality
│   ├── module_helper.py              # Scan & manage modules
│   ├── language_helper.py            # Manage language packs
│   ├── theme_helper.py               # Theme/Design helpers
│   ├── user_helper.py                # User/Role helpers
│   ├── setup_helper.py               # Initial setup
│   └── maintenance_helper.py         # Maintenance tasks
│
├── management/commands/              # Django-integrated Commands
│   ├── backup.py                     # Calls backup_helper
│   ├── setup_roles.py                # Set up roles
│   └── scan_modules.py               # Scan modules

10.3 backup_helper.py

Contains the core logic for backup operations. Used both by the CLI tool backup_restore.py and the management command backup.

  • backup_file(file_path, message) – Creates a backup of a file
  • list_backups(file_path, date) – Lists backups
  • restore_file(file_path, version) – Restores a file
  • cleanup_old_backups(days) – Deletes old backups

10.4 module_helper.py

Helper functions for module management:

  • scan_modules() – Scans all modules (wrapper for ModuleScanner)
  • disable_module(module_id) – Disables a module (DB override)
  • enable_module(module_id) – Enables a module
  • reorder_modules(module_ids) – Changes the order of modules

10.5 language_helper.py

Helper functions for language pack management:

  • scan_languages() – Scans available languages from i18n/
  • add_language(lang_code) – Adds a new language (creates folder and meta.json)
  • export_language(lang_code) – Exports a language pack as ZIP
  • import_language(zip_file) – Imports a language pack
  • check_completeness(lang_code) – Checks what percentage of a language pack is translated

10.6 theme_helper.py

Helper functions for the theme system:

  • generate_theme_variables(primary_color) – Generates CSS variables for a custom theme
  • validate_theme(theme_name) – Checks if a theme is valid
  • list_themes() – Lists available themes

10.7 user_helper.py

Helper functions for user and role management:

  • create_berater(user_data) – Creates a new consultant (User + ConsultantProfile)
  • import_consultants_csv(file_path) – Imports consultants from CSV
  • assign_role(user, role) – Assigns a role to a user
  • sync_ldap_users() – Synchronizes users with LDAP

10.8 setup_helper.py

Initial system setup:

  • setup_database() – Runs migrations
  • setup_roles() – Creates default roles (Consultant, Supervisor, Dispatcher, Admin)
  • setup_demo_data() – Creates demo data for testing
  • check_system_requirements() – Checks if all dependencies are met

10.9 maintenance_helper.py

Maintenance tasks:

  • cleanup_sessions(days) – Deletes old sessions
  • cleanup_logs(days) – Rotates and deletes old logs
  • rebuild_search_index() – Rebuilds the Elasticsearch index
  • send_health_report() – Sends a health report via email

10.10 CLI vs. Django Command

PurposeUseExample
Interactive use (developer)backup_restore.pypython backup_restore.py -save models.py
